'''Bill Martinson''' was a Decipher Product Development staffer; the anagram list unscrambles [[Lieutenant Tarn Mison]] as Bill Martinson.

== Anagrams ==

A GeoCities fan page (copied onto Encyclopedia 3.2 p.200) maps these printed titles:

* [[Lieutenant Tarn Mison]] — Bill Martinson

== Other sourced notes ==

Radio Free Decipher broadcast 1 (4 December 1998, audio missing from the public rehost) listed Carol Wisely hosting with guests Bill Martinson and Tim Ellington on Star Trek CCG's Dominion expansion.

Broadcast 4 (8 January 1999) interviewed Martinson on the Trek set after Dominion and on SWCCG Endor. Broadcasts 12–13 (April 1999) paired him with Jerry Darcy on Young Jedi and Endor.

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Martinson did additional design on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001) and reviewed the game while mainly working on the Star Trek CCG.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref>
